name: ReelPing
description: ReelPing is a lightweight, self-hosted Plex Media Server status monitor and Discord notifier. It continuously checks whether your Plex server is reachable and, when a confirmed outage occurs, sends one clear Discord notification (and a recovery notice with the outage duration when Plex returns). An authenticated web interface lets you announce scheduled maintenance, "going offline now", delays, and custom messages with one click. ReelPing works with Plex hosted anywhere reachable over the network: an Unraid Docker container, a VM, another NAS, or another server. It needs NO privileged mode, NO Docker socket, NO host networking, and NO access to Plex's configuration or media — only a network URL it can reach. Enter your Plex token and Discord webhook in the authenticated web UI (never in this template). Uses Discord incoming webhooks — no Discord bot required. ReelPing is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Plex, Inc., Discord Inc., or Lime Technology, Inc.
